claim.claim-text: 1. A display apparatus, comprising:

2. The display apparatus of claim 1, wherein a first distance (D1) between the enclosure (500) and the second sides (S2a, S2b) of the vibration generating device (410, 430) is longer than each of the first length (L1) and the second length (L2).

3. The display apparatus of claim 1, wherein a first distance (D1) between the enclosure (500) and the vibration generating device (410, 430) is longer than the first length (L1) and shorter than the second length (L2).
4. The display apparatus according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the first length (L1) is shorter than the second length (L2).

5. The display apparatus according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein a second distance (D2) between the enclosure (500) and the vibration generating device (410, 430) is longer than the second length (L2).
6. The display apparatus of claim 5, wherein the second distance (D2) is 0.5 to 1.5 times the second length (L2), with respect to the second direction (Y).

7. The display apparatus according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein a first air gap (AG1) is provided between the display module (100) and the vibration plate (200), and wherein the first air gap (AG1) includes at least one second air gap (AG2) surrounding the at least one vibration-generating device (410, 430), the second air gap (AG2) being provided between the display module (100), the vibration plate (200) and the enclosure (500).

8. The display apparatus of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the enclosure (500) comprises at least one of a double-sided adhesive tape, a double-sided adhesive pad, and a double-sided foam pad.

9. The display apparatus of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the vibration-generating device (410, 430) comprises a piezoelectric material layer; and/or wherein the vibration plate (200) comprises one or more of: magnesium (Mg), aluminum (Al), an Al alloy material, a Mg alloy material, and a Mg-lithium (Li) alloy material.
10. The display apparatus of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the display module (100) comprises:

a panel guide (140) configured to support the display panel (110); a backlight unit (130) on the rear surface of the display panel (110); and a supporting cover (150) configured to support the panel guide (140) and accommodate the backlight unit (130), wherein the vibration plate (200) is provided on a rear surface of the supporting cover (150), and wherein the enclosure (500) is provided between the rear surface of the supporting cover (150) and the vibration plate (200).
11. The display apparatus of claim 10, further comprising
at least one protection member (800), the protection member (800) being provided on the rear surface of the supporting cover (150) and facing the vibration-generating device (410, 430).
12. The display apparatus of claim 10 or 11, wherein:

the supporting cover (150) comprises an opening (155) facing the vibration-generating device (410, 430); and a size of the opening (155) is wider than a size of the vibration-generating device (410, 430).

13. The display apparatus of any one of the preceding claims, further comprising: a system rear cover (600) facing a rear surface of the vibration plate (200) with a third air gap (AG3) therebetween, the system rear cover (600) comprising a rear structure (610) facing the rear surface of the vibration plate (200) and a side structure (630) surrounding a side surface of the display module (100) with a border gap (BG) therebetween.
14. The display apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a system front cover (700) covering a periphery of a front surface of the display module (110) and the border gap (BG).
